links.outcome: Clinician review of real patient-chat histories for correctness, completeness, safety, and personalization
links.effect: Clinicians rated MedEduChat as highly correct (2.9/3), complete (2.7/3), and safe (2.7/3), with moderate personalization (2.3/3).
links.quote: Clinicians evaluated the patient-chat interaction history and rated MedEduChat as highly correct (2.9/3), complete (2.7/3), and safe (2.7/3), with moderate personalization (2.3/3).

unlisted_practices: EHR-integrated LLM agent personalizing patient education, evaluated with UMUX usability and Health Confidence Score

screen.reason: Evaluates an EHR-integrated LLM agent (MedEduChat) deployed in a prospective quality improvement study with 15 real prostate cancer patients and 3 clinicians to assess usability, patient confidence, and clinician-rated safety/correctness.
